title: Late Attention Layers Alone Can Copy Entity Tokens, but Not Without Attending to Their Context
abstract: arXiv:2609.35663v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) reliably perform entity copying, in which a model copies tokens referring to an entity, termed entity tokens, from the prompt into its output to answer a question. Although entity copying is straightforward for most LLMs, existing research does not provide a systematic account of which layers specialize in this fundamental task or how other tokens in the same sequence, termed context tokens, influence the model's ability to copy the entity tokens. To address these questions, we conduct experiments on Qwen3-8B using two novel methods: genie-in-a-bottle, which controls exactly which layers can participate in an entity-copying task, and attention lobotomy, which cuts off specific tokens' attention to entity tokens without affecting the remaining attention distribution. translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够可靠地执行实体复制任务，即模型将从提示词中指代实体的词元（称为实体词元）复制到输出中以回答问题。尽管实体复制对大多数 LLM 而言轻而易举，但现有研究并未系统性地阐明哪些层专门负责这一基础任务，以及同一序列中的其他词元（称为上下文词元）如何影响模型复制实体词元的能力。为解决这些问题，我们在 Qwen3-8B 上采用两种新颖的方法进行实验：其一是“瓶中精灵”（genie-in-a-bottle）方法，可精确控制哪些层参与实体复制任务；其二是“注意力切除”（attention lobotomy）方法，可切断特定词元对实体词元的注意力，同时不影响其余注意力分布。我们发现，模型后半部分中两组不同的注意力层对于实体复制既是必要的也是充分的。此外，……
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型后半部分的两类注意力层对实体复制任务既必要又充分，但这种复制能力必须依赖对上下文词元的关注。
en_tdlr: Two distinct groups of late attention layers in LLMs are both necessary and sufficient for entity copying, but this ability fundamentally depends on attending to the entity's context tokens.
